COACH SHEM WITH A LEARNER
Move 2  ·  Nf3

Shem Messo has spent years turning quiet classrooms into competitive chess clubs.

His coaching starts with the fundamentals, how each piece thinks, not just how it moves, then builds toward real tactics, opening principles, and tournament composure. Sessions run directly in partner schools, fitted around the timetable, with materials and a clear progression path for every learner.

Outside term-time coaching, Shem organizes inter-school tournaments and supplies chess sets and study materials to schools building their own clubs.
